Clean-room WGSL port of the tonemap, a sun-only light shaft approximation and a wet-surface material, run through the engine's shader stages; stage 1 of the port. Stage 2 adds sky-mirror approximations of the metal, polished stone and glass reflections (the original planar mirrors need a second scene render). Stage 3 adds /luxium shockwave and /luxium blackhole to the air distortion pass (lensing and accretion disc ported from blackhole.fsh). Stage 4 adds a soft glow pass standing in for the Kawase blur chain and /luxium explosion, a raymarched fireball standing in for the particle and fluid-grid explosion.
